relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: elevated TNF-α in the ACC activates the NF-κB pathway, up-regulating acid-sensing ion channel 1a and subsequently enhancing the activity of ACC glutamatergic neurons

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: also promotes necroptosis of parvalbumin-expressing interneurons

relationships.subject: mitophagy
relationships.evidence_quote: deficient mitophagy in microglia facilitates NOD-, LRR- and pyrin domain-containing protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome-driven neuroinflammation via mitochondrial ROS

relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: our study reveals that DEGs in the ACC under NP are enriched in TNF and NF-κB signaling pathways

relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Notably, Bcl3 and Irf7 were down-regulated in the NP model, whereas Hipk2 and Tfap2b were up-regulated.

key_findings: RNA-seq of ACC and MCC at 2 and 4 weeks post-SNI shows time-dependent increase in DEGs, with enrichment of synaptic plasticity and TNF/NF-kB neuroinflammation pathways.
ACC shows late-phase mitochondrial dysfunction/neurodegeneration pathways; hub genes are interferon-stimulated genes early and ribosomal proteins late.
